weight_two.proof: For two distinct antipodal classes [v] and [w], a direction L is silent exactly when L(v)^2=L(w)^2. Factoring gives L(v-w)=0 or L(v+w)=0. Since v-w and v+w are nonzero, this gives at most their two annihilator directions; they may coincide when v and w are linearly dependent. Thus z<=2 and 2+(32-z)>=32.
weight_two.bound_is_sharp: For noncollinear v,w, the annihilators of v-w and v+w are distinct, so z=2.

weight_four.symmetry_break: Any counterexample has at least three silent directions; PGL(2,31) triple transitivity fixes them to 0,1,31.
weight_four.coverage_argument: Every four-set silent in directions 0,1,31 has zero total 48-bit fibre signature. Each of its three unordered 2+2 partitions is therefore a disjoint pair of enumerated pairs with equal signatures. Every collision was independently replayed in all 32 directions.
weight_four.independent_replay: scripts.p31_group_branch_cms.verify reconstructed the displayed support with weight four, silent directions [0,1,2,31], active count 28, branch weight 32, and counterexample=false.

scope: Exact p=31 grouped-uncertainty closure only at point weights two and four; not the full grouped inequality, row-code distance, residual (ii), E1, or the original MO limit.
